writeups.title: HTB Writeup: Media
writeups.summary: Windows compromise through media playlist NTLM capture, upload path redirection with an NTFS junction, FullPowers token recovery and GodPotato SYSTEM escalation.

writeups.title: HTB Writeup: Pov
writeups.summary: ASP.NET path traversal exposes machine keys, enabling ViewState RCE, credential recovery from CLIXML and SYSTEM access through SeDebugPrivilege token abuse.

writeups.title: HTB Writeup: Jeeves
writeups.summary: Jenkins script console command execution leads to a user shell, KeePass database recovery, Administrator hash extraction and root flag discovery in an NTFS alternate data stream.

writeups.title: HTB Writeup: TombWatcher
writeups.summary: Active Directory chain from supplied credentials to fake SPN Kerberoasting, gMSA password recovery, object ownership abuse and ESC15 certificate escalation.

writeups.title: HTB Writeup: Facts
writeups.summary: Camaleon CMS account takeover leads to MinIO credentials, encrypted SSH key recovery and root through sudo facter custom facts.

writeups.title: HTB Writeup: Conversor
writeups.summary: XSLT processing writes a malicious script for command execution, SQLite leaks credentials and sudo needrestart abuse creates a SUID root shell.

writeups.title: HTB Writeup: Analytics
writeups.summary: Metabase pre-auth RCE exposes container environment credentials, leading to SSH access and root via vulnerable Ubuntu OverlayFS behavior.

writeups.title: HTB Writeup: Dog
writeups.summary: Exposed .git data leaks Backdrop credentials, CMS RCE gives a shell, password reuse pivots to SSH and sudo Bee eval executes commands as root.

writeups.title: HTB Writeup: Usage
writeups.summary: SQL injection leaks an admin hash, laravel-admin avatar upload gives RCE, and a root backup helper is abused through wildcard behavior.

writeups.title: HTB Writeup: Cap
writeups.summary: An IDOR exposes packet captures containing credentials, which lead to SSH access and root via Python cap_setuid capability abuse.

writeups.title: HTB Writeup: Editorial
writeups.summary: SSRF exposes an internal API with credentials, Git history reveals a second user password and a vulnerable GitPython workflow is abused for root.

writeups.title: HTB Writeup: Trickster
writeups.summary: A long chain from exposed Git and PrestaShop RCE to container SSTI, backup credential recovery and PrusaSlicer post-processing abuse for root.

writeups.title: HTB Writeup: Instant
writeups.summary: APK decompilation exposes API context and JWT usage, an authenticated LFI retrieves SSH material and Solar-PuTTY backups reveal the root password.

writeups.title: HTB Writeup: Chemistry
writeups.summary: A malicious CIF file exploits pymatgen for RCE, SQLite hashes provide SSH access and aiohttp static-file traversal reads root-owned files.

writeups.title: HTB Writeup: Sightless
writeups.summary: SQLPad RCE lands in a container, shadow cracking provides SSH access and an internal admin panel command field is abused to expose the root flag.

writeups.title: HTB Writeup: Escape
writeups.summary: Active Directory compromise through guest-readable SMB content, MSSQL NetNTLMv2 coercion, credential recovery from SQL logs, and AD CS ESC1 abuse.

writeups.title: HTB Writeup: Certificate
writeups.summary: Web upload abuse, database credential recovery, Account Operators pivots, SeManageVolumePrivilege and forged AD CS certificates.

writeups.title: HTB Writeup: Eighteen
writeups.summary: MSSQL impersonation, PBKDF2 cracking and Windows Server 2025 BadSuccessor abuse to recover Administrator access.

writeups.title: HTB Writeup: Darkzero
writeups.summary: MSSQL links, reverse tunneling, Kerberos certificate abuse, token impersonation and unconstrained delegation across domain controllers.

writeups.title: HTB Writeup: Manager
writeups.summary: MSSQL file discovery exposes Raven credentials, leading to AD CS ESC7 abuse and Administrator authentication.

writeups.title: HTB Writeup: Forest
writeups.summary: AS-REP roasting of svc-alfresco, Account Operators abuse, Exchange Windows Permissions and DCSync.

writeups.title: HTB Writeup: Puppy
writeups.summary: Group write abuse, KeePass recovery, DPAPI credential decryption and DCSync to Administrator.

writeups.title: HTB Writeup: Jab
writeups.summary: XMPP user discovery, AS-REP roasting, ExecuteDCOM access and Openfire RCE to SYSTEM.

writeups.title: HTB Writeup: Administrator
writeups.summary: Password reset chain, Password Safe recovery, Kerberoasting and DCSync to Administrator.

writeups.title: HTB Writeup: Cicada
writeups.summary: SMB and LDAP credential disclosure, developer share secrets and SeBackupPrivilege abuse to recover Administrator hash.

writeups.title: HTB Writeup: Mailing
writeups.summary: hMailServer LFI, Outlook NTLM leak and LibreOffice exploitation for localadmin access.

writeups.title: HTB Writeup: Fluffy
writeups.summary: Active Directory attack chain from initial credentials, Kerberoasting, and AD CS (ESC16) abuse to Administrator authentication.

writeups.title: HTB Writeup: Postman
writeups.summary: Initial access through unauthenticated Redis, SSH pivot with public key, and local privilege escalation through Webmin to gain root.

writeups.title: HTB Writeup: Trick
writeups.summary: Web environment compromise using SQLi and LFI, SSH key recovery, and privilege escalation by manipulating fail2ban rules.

scripts.title: pcap-forensics
scripts.summary: Network forensics toolkit for inspecting PCAP/PCAPNG evidence, routing controlled lab traffic through Tor and producing analyst-friendly Markdown reports.
scripts.purpose: Accelerate packet capture triage and preserve repeatable evidence during lab or authorized network analysis.
scripts.workflow: Parse captures with tshark, extract relevant indicators, document traffic behavior and generate Markdown summaries for reporting.
scripts.outputs: Markdown reports, extracted network indicators, capture notes and reproducible command evidence.
scripts.safeUse: Built for offline captures, personal labs and explicitly authorized assessment evidence.

scripts.title: recon-toolkit
scripts.summary: Reconnaissance toolkit for web, DNS and network discovery, combining shell automation with Python helpers for fingerprinting and report conversion.
scripts.purpose: Standardize early assessment discovery so recon output is consistent, reviewable and easier to hand off.
scripts.workflow: Run DNS checks, web reconnaissance, Nmap scans, ffuf discovery and technology fingerprinting from a repeatable toolkit structure.
scripts.outputs: Recon notes, scan artifacts, Nmap-derived HTML/XLSX reports and target technology summaries.
scripts.safeUse: Intended for owned assets, scoped assessments and training environments only.

scripts.title: username-generator
scripts.summary: Identity automation utility for generating clean username lists from CSV/XLSX sources with normalization, formatting and duplicate handling.
scripts.purpose: Create consistent user identifier candidates for internal review, access validation or authorized password audit preparation.
scripts.workflow: Load spreadsheet data, normalize names, apply username formats, remove duplicates and separate invalid entries for manual review.
scripts.outputs: Clean username lists, invalid-entry files and repeatable CSV/XLSX processing artifacts.
scripts.safeUse: Designed for authorized identity data processing and internal testing workflows.

scripts.title: web-screenshot-reporter
scripts.summary: Visual evidence reporter that captures web screenshots in batch mode and builds a navigable HTML index for asset and exposure reviews.
scripts.purpose: Turn large web target lists into reviewable visual evidence for assessment scoping, reporting and triage.
scripts.workflow: Read target URLs, capture screenshots, organize output folders and generate an HTML gallery for fast analyst review.
scripts.outputs: Screenshot sets, local HTML evidence index and visual asset review material.
scripts.safeUse: Use only against owned, approved or lab targets where screenshot collection is permitted.

scripts.title: pentest-lab-scripts
scripts.summary: Controlled offensive lab collection for validating testing behavior, collecting evidence and improving report automation in non-production environments.
scripts.purpose: Keep exploit validation and reporting helpers isolated from client work while demonstrating offensive scripting capability.
scripts.workflow: Run lab-only helpers for proxy collection, XML-RPC validation, WPScan report handling and controlled webadmin exploitation exercises.
scripts.outputs: Lab evidence, validation notes, parser output and repeatable offensive testing artifacts.
scripts.safeUse: Strictly scoped to controlled labs, intentionally vulnerable targets and explicitly authorized testing.
